requiredFor: GTFS stops.txt export and Map display
reason: Official DPR (SOURCE-001) specifies station chainage in linear meters (Table 4.3) and street alignments, but does not contain geographic WGS84 latitude/longitude coordinates.

requiredFor: GTFS shapes.txt export and high-precision route visualization
reason: DPR Table 4.2 provides curve radii and transition lengths, but does not provide continuous GPS shape point polylines.

requiredFor: Passenger-facing UI and GTFS stop_name accuracy
reason: DPR (2011) lists tentative planning names (e.g. Bandra Metro/ITO, CSIA Domestic, CSIA International, Science Museum, Shitla Devi Temple) which were renamed prior to 2024 commissioning (BKC, CSMIA T1, CSMIA T2, Science Centre, Sitladevi).

requiredFor: Digital Twin detailed track topology and reversal simulation
reason: DPR Section 4.4.3 mentions reversal facilities at Cuffe Parade, ITO/BKC, and SEEPZ, but exact turnout chainages are left to detailed design stage.

requiredFor: Journey Engine operational filtering (Active vs Under Construction)
reason: DPR specifies full corridor construction, but actual operational opening is phased (Phase 1 Aarey-BKC commissioned Oct 2024; Phase 2 BKC-Cuffe Parade ongoing).

requiredFor: Digital Twin station gate mapping and GTFS pathway access points
reason: DPR Table 4.39 lists land plot areas and purposes for station entrances, but does not provide exact GPS latitude/longitude coordinates for individual gate structures.

requiredFor: Detailed 3D Digital Twin station navigation and GTFS pathways.txt export
reason: DPR Chapter 5 specifies platform length (250m) and staircase/escalator sizing criteria, but does not contain indoor 3D line geometry or explicit walkway distances.

requiredFor: Real-time accessibility routing and station status reporting
reason: DPR Table 5.4 specifies proposed Lift and Escalator counts per station, but does not reflect current operational availability or maintenance status.

requiredFor: Journey Engine multi-modal transfer penalty calculation and GTFS transfers.txt export
reason: DPR Table 4.4 documents interchange relationships (e.g. Churchgate WR, CSTM, Marol Naka Line 1), but intentionally omits precise walking transfer times.

requiredFor: Station concourse capacity modeling
reason: DPR Section 5.3 outlines general AFC gate design principles, but station-by-station gate array layouts are finalized in detailed design stage.

requiredFor: GTFS calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt export
reason: DPR Section 0.6 and JICA Report (SOURCE-003) specify proposed 05:00-24:00 operating window, but current 2026 operational timetable span must be verified against operator published schedule.

requiredFor: GTFS frequencies.txt export
reason: DPR Table 0.11 specifies proposed 260s/180s/150s design headways, but current operational headway frequencies must be verified against current commercial schedule.

requiredFor: GTFS stop_times.txt exact station arrival/departure schedule generation
reason: DPR specifies overall terminal launch window (05:00-24:00), but does not provide individual station-by-station first/last train timetables.

requiredFor: Digital Twin active train count validation
reason: DPR Table 0.12 specifies proposed 35/47/55 rake allocations across time horizons, but does not record current 2026 active revenue fleet deployment.

requiredFor: Journey Engine real-time dwell calibration and delay prediction
reason: DPR Section 0.6 specifies a nominal 30s station dwell design parameter, but real-world observed dwell distributions belong to Category H/I evidence.

requiredFor: Digital Twin vehicle model and performance calibration
reason: DPR Table 0.4 specifies proposed 6/8-car stainless steel rakes; delivered 8-car Alstom Metropolis trainsets (2022-2024) must be verified against manufacturer specification sheets.

requiredFor: Physics-based traction power simulation
reason: DPR Table 3.7 specifies proposed 42T tare weight per car and 17T axle load limit, but actual tare mass of delivered commercial trainsets requires operator technical verification.

requiredFor: High-precision physics schedule synthesis
reason: DPR Table 0.4 specifies maximum design acceleration (1.1 m/s²) and service deceleration (1.0 m/s²); actual revenue service acceleration curves belong to Category H/I evidence.

requiredFor: Real-time crowd modeling and coach recommendation engine
reason: DPR Table 3.6 specifies design passenger densities (3 and 6 persons/m²); actual peak hour passenger occupancy and crush density belong to Category I observations.

requiredFor: CO2 savings and sustainability analytics model
reason: DPR Section 0.8 specifies a baseline energy consumption target of 70 kWh/1000 GTKM, but actual commercial energy recovery figures require telemetry logging.
